title: AI chat (native tools): no system prompt is sent, so a local model guesses entity names and parameter shapes

labels.name: source:agent

labels.name: area:mcp

body:
Found by QA brief q08 on v0.25.0 (preset "Offline local (Ollama)", qwen3-coder:latest). The captured requests to `/v1/chat/completions` carry only `model`, `max_tokens`, `messages` and `tools` - no system message in any of the 46 rounds. In Native mode `split_payload` (`crates/app/src/ai/wire.rs`) returns `system: None`; only the Prompt-JSON and Read-Only fallbacks send instructions. `camcraft-cli mcp prompt` already prints a compact prompt meant for local models, but the panel does not use it.

**Effect seen in the run** (the app refused each one correctly, so these are model mistakes, but each cost a tool round out of the 12-round cap):
- `add_operation` with `source: "Selection 1"` (get_job shows `source: {selection: 1}`) and `list_features` on `"Model1"` (the model is `plate`).
- `add_operation` / `edit_operation` patches wrapped in `{"pocket": {...}}`, copied from the shape get_job prints; refused with "a pocket operation has no field pocket".
- `strategy: "pocket"`; deleting and re-adding an operation instead of `edit_operation`; no rule to ask before deleting (see the companion bug about confirmation).
Turns 2, 3 and 4 of the brief all hit "stopped after 12 tool steps without a final answer".

**Proposal:** in Native mode send a short system prompt: the rules from `mcp prompt` (flat params patch, one undo per change, edit rather than delete-and-re-add, ask before destructive edits) and a one-line document context (model names, operation names and kinds, tool names, units).

Evidence: transcript https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/qa-artifacts/qa/q08/q08-20261122T131017Z/q08-transcript.json (meta.system_prompt_sent = false; turns 2-4), panel https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/qa-artifacts/qa/q08/q08-20261122T131017Z/13-step2.png, https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/qa-artifacts/qa/q08/q08-20261122T131017Z/15-step4.png.

Done means: a Native-mode request from the AI chat carries a system message with the rules and the document's entity names (pinned by a transport test on the built request body), and a replayed q08 turn (issue 3411) no longer needs a lookup call to learn the model name.
